Check classification validation rank stability

Source: R/check-validation-stability.R
check_validation_stability.Rd

Score fitted binary classifiers on their shared testing split, then measure how well their score rankings survive a paired bootstrap. Each draw samples testing rows with replacement within outcome classes and uses those same rows for all models. Models are not refitted.

Usage

check_validation_stability(
  .model_tbl,
  .metric_fn = yardstick::roc_auc,
  .n_boot = 25L,
  .event_level = "first",
  .seed = NULL
)

Arguments

.model_tbl

A fitted table from fast_classification(). Use models fitted and evaluated on the same split. Unfitted entries are ignored.

.metric_fn

A binary probability metric with the interface of yardstick::roc_auc(), returning one numeric .estimate.

.n_boot

A positive integer giving the number of bootstrap draws.

.event_level

"first" or "second": the outcome factor level whose predicted probability is supplied to .metric_fn.

.seed

Optional integer seed. A supplied seed leaves the caller's RNG state unchanged.

Value

A numeric scalar: the mean Spearman correlation of the full testing scores with the bootstrap scores. Undefined draws are omitted. Returns NA_real_ when stability cannot be estimated, including when there are fewer than two fitted models, either class is absent, or all full-sample scores are tied. A non-finite full-sample metric or invalid testing probabilities also make the result unavailable.

See also

vgc_gate()

Examples

data <- transform(mtcars, am = factor(am))
rec <- recipes::recipe(am ~ mpg + hp, data = data)
models <- withr::with_seed(1L, fast_classification(data, rec, .parsnip_eng = c("lm","glm")))
check_validation_stability(models) # One model cannot establish a ranking.
#> [1] NA
